title: FilterBar
wrapsNative: MonarchSearchBar over an androidx.compose.foundation.horizontalScroll Row of MonarchButton (Filters), MonarchTag filter and removable chips (MonarchChip and MonarchButton) and MonarchButton, with MonarchFacetedFilterPanel in a MonarchBottomSheet
summary: A recipe, not a component: search, a sideways-scrolling row of filter chips (Filters, quick toggles, applied filters you can remove, Clear all) and the result count above a list; the full filter set opens in a sheet.
whenToUse: Above a list or table with filters applied, so people can see, change and remove them, and for one-tap quick filters such as Assigned to me.
whenNotToUse: For switching between exclusive views use tabs or a segmented button; for tags on a record use MonarchBadge or MonarchTag; for a few sort options use a MonarchMenu.
api: MonarchSearchBar(query = query, onQueryChange = { query = it }, onSearch = {}, placeholder = "Search tickets")

Row(Modifier.horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState())) { AssistChip(onClick = { sheet = true }, label = { Text("Filters (2)") }); MonarchTag(text = …, selected = …, onSelectedChange = …); MonarchTag(text = "Status: Open", onRemove = …, removeIcon = …); TextButton(onClick = clearAll) { Text("Clear all") } }
MonarchText(text = "12 results", modifier = Modifier.semantics { liveRegion = LiveRegionMode.Polite })
ModalBottomSheet(onDismissRequest = …) { MonarchFacetedFilterPanel(facets = …, value = filters, onValueChange = { filters = it }) { MonarchButton(text = "Show results", …) } }

appearance: Material 3 chips in Monarch colors: outlined when off, filled when a quick filter is on; removable chips with the app's close glyph; the result count as body text. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web FilterBar is a wrapping toolbar with MonarchChip (removable, editable in a popover, or a toggle with a count), a FilterMenu (Add filter), Clear all, a result count, trailing controls, URL helpers and an optional collapse into a sheet below a width. On a phone the native pattern is a single sideways-scrolling chip row under the search field, with the full filter set in a bottom sheet, so this recipe uses Material 3 chips and MonarchFacetedFilterPanel in a MonarchBottomSheet instead of popovers per chip; Add filter becomes the Filters chip. Search parameters in the URL have no counterpart: keep the filters in the screen's state or ViewModel. iOS has no entry yet; its plan is also a recipe.
accessibility: The Filters chip is a button whose name carries the count, "Filters (2)".
Quick filters are filter chips that report selected.
Each removable chip's remove target is named, "Remove Status: Open", and has a 48dp target from MonarchTag.
The result count is a polite live region, so a change is announced.
The sheet is a modal pane; back and the scrim close it.
edgeCases: Keep the chip row on one line with horizontalScroll; at font scale 2.0 people scroll it.
Clear the applied chips when Clear all is pressed, and close the sheet with Show results.
MonarchFacetedFilterPanel is not lazy: in the sheet put it in a verticalScroll Column.
